Command: Sanctify every firstborn male to the LORD
Summary: The command: Sanctify every firstborn male to the LORD (Exodus 13:2). The firstborn male, of both man and beast, belonged to the LORD from birth, set apart in memory of the Exodus.
Commandment: Sanctify every firstborn male to the LORD, as prescribed in Exodus 13:2.
Application: It cannot be practised as written without the standing temple and Aaronic priesthood; its enduring lesson is God's holiness, the cost of atonement, and worship offered exactly as God appoints.
Purpose: Scripture's stated reason: because the LORD slew all the firstborn in Egypt and spared Israel's, therefore the firstborn are his (Exodus 13:14-15).
